_note: Hand-verified 2026-08-24, ratified by Dave. USASpending carries NO LEI and NO CIK, so every row here is a NAME judgement and is recorded as one. Anything not listed is REJECTED BY OMISSION -- the fetcher will not attribute an award it cannot evidence.
_method: `exact` = recipient name identical to the anchor legal name after stripping legal-form suffixes (INC, CORP, LLC, LP, HOLDINGS, GROUP, ...). `verified-subsidiary` = the recipient appears in that anchor's OWN Exhibit 21 subsidiary list, checked against sources/screening/exhibit21.json. No other band is admissible: the fetcher's CHECK constraint accepts only these two.
_known_limitation: Exhibit 21 is MATERIALITY-FILTERED at source and only 22 of 50 anchors have one indexed, so "absent from Exhibit 21" is absence of evidence, NOT evidence of absence. 40 candidate rows totalling $838,433,710 were dropped on this basis, including several that are probably genuine (AeroControlex, Whippany Actuation, XPO Logistics Worldwide Government Services). They are excluded because they could not be evidenced from this estate, not because they were disproved. The concentration measure is therefore a FLOOR.

_rejected_examples.why: unrelated defense contractor; largest single false positive in the sweep
